title: Finite presentation is equivalent across elementary module devissage
statement: Let $f:X\to S$ be a morphism of schemes locally of finite type, $\mathcal F$ a finite-type quasi-coherent $\mathcal O_X$-module, and $x\in\operatorname{Supp}(\mathcal F_s)$, $s=f(x)$. Let $g:(X',x')\to(X,x)$ and $e:(S',s')\to(S,s)$ be elementary etale neighbourhoods (etale and inducing isomorphisms of residue fields at the marked points), and let $f':X'\to S'$ satisfy $fg=ef'$. Suppose $X',Z',Y',S'$ are affine, $i:Z'\to X'$ is a closed immersion of finite presentation, $\pi:Z'\to Y'$ is finite over $S'$, $h:Y'\to S'$ is smooth of relative dimension $n=\dim_x\operatorname{Supp}(\mathcal F_s)$ with geometrically integral fibres, and $\mathcal G$ is a finite-type quasi-coherent $\mathcal O_{Z'}$-module with $i_*\mathcal G\cong g^*\mathcal F$. Let $z'\in Z'$ satisfy $i(z')=x'$, put $y'=\pi(z')$, and assume $h(y')=s'$, $\pi^{-1}(y')=\{z'\}$ and $\kappa(y')/\kappa(s')$ purely transcendental. These are precisely the elementary devissage data of [lem-trf-elementary-module-devissage], with module pullback [def-pc-module-pullback]; explicitly $X_s=X\times_S\operatorname{Spec}\kappa(s)$ and $\mathcal F_s$ is the pullback of $\mathcal F$ to $X_s$ [def-pc-fibre-product]. Schemes, affine spectra, quasi-coherence, finite type, dimension, smoothness, etaleness, finite morphisms, closed immersions, finite presentation of morphisms, residue fields, integrality and purely transcendental extensions have the meanings of [def-pc-scheme], [def-weil-affine-spectrum], [pqf-def-coherent], [def-weil-finite-type-morphism], [def-kun-dimension], [def-sbc-smooth-morphisms], [def-weil-etale-morphism], [def-weil-finite-integral-morphism], [def-weil-closed-immersion], [def-sbc-locally-finite-presentation], [def-weil-residue-field], [def-pc-integral-scheme], [def-trf-purely-transcendental-extension]. Assume additionally that $f$ is locally of finite presentation [def-sbc-locally-finite-presentation]. Then $\pi$ is of finite presentation. The following conditions are equivalent: $\mathcal F$ is of finite presentation on some neighbourhood of $x$; $\mathcal G$ is of finite presentation on some neighbourhood of $z'$; $\pi_*\mathcal G$ is of finite presentation on some neighbourhood of $y'$. Also the following stalkwise conditions are equivalent: $\mathcal F_x$ is finitely presented over $\mathcal O_{X,x}$; $\mathcal G_{z'}$ is finitely presented over $\mathcal O_{Z',z'}$; $(\pi_*\mathcal G)_{y'}$ is finitely presented over $\mathcal O_{Y',y'}$ [def-sc-finitely-presented-module]. Finite presentation of module sheaves is [def-weil-pbc-module-finite-type-presentation].
